digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup/initialization and per-operation config composition
propositions: MCP and review-bot must capture static deployment/startup config once at service initialization rather than re-reading it per operation, while preserving request-scoped inbound auth and SDK-native credential refresh.

Each operation/request must receive a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot with composed config, while inbound bearer tokens remain transient request context via PROXY_IDENTITY and never enter startup/operation snapshots or serialization.
Decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM credentials) must be validated before accepting job/webhook work, with no principal fallback and no lazy validation inside operation handlers.
Static binding changes (env/file mutation) are observed only after process restart/redeploy; the running process retains its startup bindings unchanged.

Partial or rejected telemetry provider auth (Langfuse/OTLP) disables telemetry with no-op behavior and leaves the underlying operation result unchanged, while security/load-bearing auth remains fail-closed.
Review-bot adapter must thread the composed S4 LLMRuntime from startup binding through CodeReviewRequest and code review decision logic via get_runner with forwarded runtime.
